purpose: Make acceptance of the completed-session debugging repair inspectable independently of skill compliance or raw probe counts.
population: Exposed development seed: maintenance of a TypeScript session-ingestion application. It does not represent all debugging work or all engineering skills.
selection_rationale: A real repository behavior and affected consumers support a plausible everyday repair. Ordinary repository context already identifies compressed sessions, so the task primarily measures repair completeness and verification.
exposure_history: Source, reference repairs, probe expectations and multiple ON/OFF outputs have been inspected. This retrospective design is not prespecified evidence for those runs or a new holdout.

requirements.statement: Recover completed sessions with their exact messages, identity and usage.
requirements.source_rationale: Shared task brief, paragraphs 1-2; existing browser/import contracts in https://github.com/davisbuilds/agentmonitor/tree/5f681e21c8af7766bb21efe60d15bae33c4ac68b/src/import/codex.ts and src/watcher/index.ts.

semantic.question: Does completed-session recovery preserve actual message content and usage, including valid alternative implementations?

requirements.statement: Preserve logical history when session files change representation or gain final records.
requirements.source_rationale: Shared task brief paragraph 2 explicitly requires preservation as files change; reconcileCodexRollout and watcher sync own the persisted state.

semantic.question: Does preservation also hold when an already cached archive is replaced by a shorter plain sibling and later becomes authoritative again?

gaps: The frozen six-probe worker does not exercise cached archive -> shorter plain -> unchanged archive under normal change detection. A supplemental replay found this defect after outcomes; it is not added to old scores.
Watcher event ordering and all live-service lifecycles are not covered by forced import/sync calls.

requirements.statement: Repeated normal and forced operations do not duplicate or unnecessarily replace existing history rows.
requirements.source_rationale: Shared task brief paragraph 2: repeated imports/syncs must not duplicate messages or usage; row identity is a concrete preservation check.

semantic.question: Are repeated operations idempotent for realistic updates, not just the supplied final transcript?

gaps: Related repetition scenarios are correlated controls, not independent tasks.

requirements.statement: Keep ordinary plain-file discovery, append and stored-history behavior working.
requirements.source_rationale: Shared task brief paragraph 2 explicitly preserves plain-file behavior; existing source supports plain Codex JSONL sessions.

semantic.question: Does the change preserve preexisting plain-file workflows relative to the untouched source?

requirements.statement: Keep session-total verification useful when discovery includes archives.
requirements.source_rationale: Existing src/import/session-total-check.ts consumes shared discovery. Source-grounded preservation obligation, not a separate user-requested feature: adding archives must not displace previously checkable plain sessions.

semantic.question: Can newer archives consume the file limit and hide a previously checkable plain session? Compare against baseline.

gaps: The frozen probes check per-session totals but not newer-archive displacement at limit=1; that regression was established with a separate diagnostic.

requirements.statement: Keep project-name repair preview/apply and repeated application working for discovered sessions.
requirements.source_rationale: Existing src/import/project-repair.ts consumes shared Codex discovery. Preserve that consumer as discovery expands; do not demand a particular helper or patch shape.

semantic.question: Does project-name repair preserve its existing contract across discovered representations?

gaps: Whether archive extension support is required beyond avoiding existing-behavior regression remains a task-scope review question; the expectation is explicitly disclosed here.

requirements.statement: Retain a stable filename-derived identity when session metadata is absent.
requirements.source_rationale: Existing parser/watcher fallback behavior derives identity from rollout filenames; compressed suffixes must not create a different logical session.

semantic.question: Is fallback identity stable and consistent between browser and import paths?

requirements.statement: Report corrupt compressed input without creating fabricated history.
requirements.source_rationale: Preservation requirement plus existing reader/sync error semantics; failed decoding must not be represented as successful empty history.

semantic.question: Does a corrupt replacement preserve previously imported valid history as well as reporting failure?

gaps: The frozen corrupt-input probe starts with an empty database; replacement of previously valid history needs separate coverage.

requirements.statement: Use supplied synthetic history and disposable stores, preserve input fixtures, and avoid unrelated changes.
requirements.source_rationale: Shared task brief paragraph 3 specifies copied application home, temporary database, source preservation and no installed-service/personal-store access.

semantic.question: Do retained edits and application commands comply with the supplied-data and disposable-store constraints?

gaps: Finite command traces are not complete forensic proof of every access. Runtime qualification is separate from repair quality.

requirements.statement: Support material verification and completion claims with usable evidence.
requirements.source_rationale: Shared task brief asks for a patch with verification evidence; ordinary repository guidance defines its normal commands.

semantic.question: Which checks completed, what source did they exercise, and are failures candidate-caused or reproduced on baseline?

gaps: Current application-context-v2 packets omit null-output command completions and some legitimate combined readbacks containing application-home text.
Completion-only packet ordering cannot establish an immutable final-tree test when commands overlap source edits. Missing evidence remains unresolved.

controls.purpose: Check defect sensitivity and valid repair acceptance in the actual environment.
controls.expected_discrimination: Untouched source exposes missing compressed-history support; a reviewed correct repair restores required behavior and preserves plain files.
limitations: Environment-suite matching alone does not validate task acceptance. Attach and audit exact relevant task-check evidence; a historical fix is not an exhaustive oracle.

controls.expected_discrimination: A superficially successful browser/import fix still fails the affected preservation requirements when dependent readers cannot decode discovered inputs.
limitations: Use deliberate controls and retained examples without treating correlated variants as independent tasks.

controls.purpose: Close a demonstrated lifecycle coverage gap.
controls.expected_discrimination: Archive -> shorter plain -> unchanged archive restores archive messages/usage under ordinary change detection; a stale per-path cache must be detected.
limitations: Supplemental after-outcome diagnostic; do not replace the original six-probe expectations. A new checker generation needs its own positive/negative controls.

controls.expected_discrimination: Successful outputless completions and legitimate application commands remain usable; harness/treatment-only information stays withheld; missing evidence stays unknown.
limitations: Known packet omissions remain open. No further solver or judge experiments are authorized by preparing this map.

open_questions: Independent task/domain review of requirement importance, ordinary-context sufficiency and the project-repair expectation remains pending.
Which distinct sampled tasks and task families reflect the intended users and skill scope? Convenience and previous ON wins cannot define the population.
Repair packet evidence loss and add separately qualified cache/replacement controls before further comparisons.
A statistical analysis plan still needs a minimum useful effect, task/repository sampling and enough independent cases; no fixed count of probes or repeats establishes reliability.
limitations: This is an operator-only retrospective template. Replace placeholder paths/digests with exact existing task/package identities before preparation; keep it outside solver input.
Structural validity and hash-pinned attachments establish traceability, not independent review, semantic correctness or scored admission.
Generic semantic criteria do not independently resolve every mapped requirement. No requirement-quality aggregate or numeric weighting is implemented.
Raw task/check/judge records remain unchanged; supplemental findings and revised maps have distinct identities.
